en.title: Full Stack Developer (MERN Stack)
en.text: Developed and maintained scalable full-stack web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) and Next.js. Focused on clean architecture, performance optimization, API integration, and Agile development practices.
list: Designed and developed scalable full-stack applications using the MERN stack and Next.js following modern engineering standards.
Built and integrated RESTful APIs and third-party services to enhance application performance and functionality.
Managed MongoDB databases with strong focus on schema design, indexing, and query optimization.
Collaborated with UI/UX designers, QA engineers, and backend developers to deliver high-quality production-ready applications.
Maintained code quality through Git version control, peer code reviews, debugging, and structured deployment workflows.
Participated actively in Agile/Scrum methodologies including sprint planning, standups, and technical discussions.

es.title: Desarrollador Full Stack (MERN Stack)
es.text: Desarrollé y mantuve aplicaciones web full-stack escalables utilizando el stack MERN (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) y Next.js. Enfoque en arquitectura limpia, optimización de rendimiento, integración de APIs y metodologías Agile.
list: Diseñé y desarrollé aplicaciones full-stack escalables utilizando MERN y Next.js siguiendo estándares modernos.
Integré APIs RESTful y servicios de terceros para mejorar el rendimiento y funcionalidad.
Gestioné bases de datos MongoDB con enfoque en diseño de esquemas, indexación y optimización de consultas.
Colaboré con equipos de UI/UX, QA y backend para entregar aplicaciones de alta calidad.
Mantuve la calidad del código usando Git, revisiones de código y procesos de despliegue estructurados.
Participé activamente en metodologías Agile/Scrum.

fr.title: Développeur Full Stack (MERN Stack)
fr.text: Développement et maintenance d'applications web full-stack évolutives utilisant la stack MERN (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) et Next.js. Accent sur une architecture propre, l'optimisation des performances, l'intégration d'API et les méthodes Agile.
list: Conception et développement d'applications full-stack évolutives avec MERN et Next.js.
Intégration d'API RESTful et de services tiers pour améliorer les fonctionnalités.
Optimisation des bases de données MongoDB (schéma, indexation, requêtes).
Collaboration avec les équipes UI/UX, QA et backend pour livrer des solutions de qualité.
Maintien de la qualité du code via Git, revues de code et workflows de déploiement.
Participation active aux processus Agile/Scrum.

ko.title: 풀스택 개발자 (MERN 스택)
ko.text: MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js 및 Next.js를 사용하여 확장 가능한 풀스택 웹 애플리케이션을 개발 및 유지보수했습니다. 클린 아키텍처, 성능 최적화, API 통합 및 Agile 개발 방식에 집중했습니다.
list: MERN 스택과 Next.js를 활용하여 확장 가능한 풀스택 애플리케이션 설계 및 개발.
RESTful API 및 외부 서비스 통합으로 기능 향상.
MongoDB 데이터베이스 스키마 설계 및 쿼리 최적화.
UI/UX, QA, 백엔드 팀과 협업하여 고품질 소프트웨어 제공.
Git 기반 코드 관리 및 코드 리뷰 수행.
Agile/Scrum 프로세스에 적극 참여.
